title: wiretap: do more custom block processing in pcapng.c.
description:
Set rec_type and the setup of the PEN-independent fields of a wtap_rec's
custom block data in pcapng_read_custom_block().  Absorb what's left of
pcapng_handle_generic_custom_block() into pcapng_read_custom_block().

Add a wtap_setup_custom_block_rec() to do the aforementioned setting.

notes.body: enabled an automatic merge when all merge checks for 559282b46fa0a0256908a226d7426b70d8f3e4b5 pass

 /*
  * Handler routines for pcapng custom blocks with an enterprise number.
  */
-typedef bool (*custom_option_parser)(FILE_T fh, uint32_t block_payload_length,
-    section_info_t* section_info,

     wtapng_block_t* wblock,
     int* err, char** err_info);
 typedef bool (*custom_option_processor)(wtapng_block_t* wblock,
